spans.s:
ind.
Now, at present.
E.
इदस् this, irregularly formed.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Of or belonging to the present.
E.
अधुना, and द्युल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, trembling.
E.
आङ् before धु or धू to tremble, affix क्त; it is also long, आधूत.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, agitated, trembling.
E.
आङ् before धूत shaken.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
New, recent, of the present moment.
E.
अधुना now, and ठक् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Weakness, infirmity.
E.
अ neg. धुर्य्य to be borne, अण aff.
